headline: Readiness cratered overnight to 29 (red) on RHR, HRV and a rock-bottom battery — today's plan already calls for an easy run, so for once the plan and the body agree.
body_state: Readiness composite 29.4, band low, driver `rhr` — resting HR 54 vs your 49.9 baseline, the sharpest jump of the block. HRV last night 36ms, flagged below your normal range. Body Battery bottomed at 9 this morning (a morning under 30 means overnight recharge didn't happen). Sleep debt is now 26h over 14 days, on just 5.4h last night. TSB -16.6 still sits inside the -5…-30 productive-training band, so the fitness stimulus itself is fine — this is a recovery failure, not an overtraining one, and it hasn't been paid back since yesterday's brief flagged the same debt.
session: Today's plan is the 7km Easy Run @ 4:50-5:19/km (`3bb62824`) — that's already the right call; the insights verdict is explicit: postpone quality, easy running only. Given the 9 battery, run the slow edge of the window or trim it short if it's not there this morning; the point today is banking base miles at true zone-2, not clearing the pace band. No calendar items booked alongside it, so there's nothing else competing for today's budget.
recent: Tuesday's tempo (Aug 12) landed at 78% of planned volume — the threshold segment ran 2.98 of 4km at 4:38/km (6-20s/km slow) with HR topping at 156, well under your 163 LT, despite an RPE 8: hard-feeling, not actually hard. Wednesday's Un1t class (Aug 13) undershot its 45-min slot again (41.2 min) at a similar zone-2/3 intensity. Monday (Aug 11) stacked a 2h hilly bike ride with a second Un1t session the same day. None of these were individually excessive, but the stacking is exactly what's showing up as this morning's RHR/HRV/battery crash — the debt from Aug 11-13 came due overnight.
focus: Today: easy or nothing — RHR, HRV and battery all agree, and the plan already matches.
Tomorrow's 13km long run needs a fresh readiness check before you commit — don't carry today's deficit into it on autopilot.
Distribution is still off (22% easy vs 80% target) — the Un1t/bike stacking is the lever to pull, not the running plan.
